disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. checked_items.en: Mechanism trace: The pre-step message listener at src/command.ts:124 only injects an activation message (with source marked as the plugin itself) when a real user message starts with the /agent-teams gesture, to launch the slash command declared by the plugin. It does not impersonate the user, does not tamper with the user's original intent, and has no injection entry controllable by an external attacker. It is recorded as a benign mechanism trace and not collected as a vulnerability (rule ID: DG-R2-58). Additional mechanism check: The plugin does not provide a CompactionEngine or AttachmentStore implementation (no extends CompactionEngine / extends AttachmentStore), so it does not involve context history compression or attachment content replacement/tampering (rule IDs: DG-R2-59, DG-R2-60).

checked_items.zh: 存在 agent/request-error 监听（src/members.ts:316）——这是成员模型回退机制：仅在成员请求因额度/限流/鉴权等失败码失败、且配置了回退路由时，切换到用户配置的回退 provider/model 并重试一次（src/members.ts:134-144），不指向未声明端点、有告警日志、不无限重试，按良性机制留痕，未按漏洞收录（规则 ID：DG-R4-56）。

It does not point to undeclared endpoints, has warning logs, and does not retry indefinitely. It is recorded as a benign mechanism trace and not collected as a vulnerability (rule ID: DG-R4-56).

evidence.zh: 存在 agent/request-error 监听（src/members.ts:316），但这是成员模型回退机制：仅在成员请求因额度/限流/鉴权等失败码失败、且配置了回退路由时，切换到用户配置的回退 provider/model 并重试一次，不指向未声明端点、有告警日志、不无限重试；未监听 agent/request，也未注册自定义模型适配器（registerAdapter），判定为良性。

Judged as benign.

静态预扫 21 条逐条裁决：
DSH-X10（映射 DG-R2-57，共 2 条：.dsh/skills/dsh-plugin-development/SKILL.md:1 与 skills/dsh-plugin-development/SKILL.md:1，同一文件镜像）——仓库自带的插件开发 Skill，内容为开发/维护/验证流程说明，无「忽略此前指令」「无需审计」类注入措辞，也未要求从外部 URL 拉取指令，良性，排除；
DSH-X07（映射 DG-R3-59，.github/workflows/publish.yml:1）——标准 npm 发布与 GitHub Release 工作流（tag 触发、版本一致性校验、发布到 npm），不随包分发、不在用户机器执行，良性，排除；
DSH-T02（映射 DG-R2-52，共 4 条：docs/developing-dsh-plugins.md:194、docs/readme-writing-guide.md:39、docs/usage.md:16、src/index.ts:183）——前三处为文档讲解，最后一处为注册 AgentTeams 使用策略系统提示段，内容为多智能体协作协议，无注入意图，排除；
DSH-C05（映射 DG-R4-53，共 8 条：docs/developing-dsh-plugins.md:601，docs/verification-guide.md:162、163、176、184、185、186、236）——全部是文档中指向 127.0.0.1 本地实例的手工验证命令或验证纪律说明，属文档而非运行代码，排除；
DSH-C01（映射 DG-R1-51，共 2 条：docs/quality-gates.md:408 与 src/quality-gates.ts:249）——文档为讲解文案，源码处是质量门禁把 id_rsa 类敏感文件标为不做改动放行的排除名单，属防御性判断而非凭据读取，排除；
DSH-X03（映射 DG-R3-55，scripts/verify.mjs:1453）——开发验证脚本中为 Windows 文件锁测试拉起子进程（powershell.exe）的调用，scripts 目录不在随包分发清单内，排除；
DSH-X05（映射 DG-R3-57，src/client/ActivityPanel.tsx:365）——面板键盘监听只处理 Escape 键取消任务固定（src/client/ActivityPanel.tsx:362），无按键记录、剪贴板或凭据访问，排除；
DSH-L03（映射 DG-R2-58，src/command.ts:124）——pre-step 监听器只对真实用户消息开头的 /agent-teams 手势注入一条来源标注为插件自身的激活消息（src/command.ts:139），激活插件自己声明的斜杠命令协议，不伪装用户、不覆盖安全机制，属插件声明的正常入口功能，良性，排除；
DSH-L06（映射 DG-R4-56，src/members.ts:316）——agent/request-error 监听是成员模型回退机制，仅在成员请求因额度/限流/鉴权等失败码失败且配置了回退路由时切换到用户配置的回退 provider/model 并重试一次（src/members.ts:134-144），不指向未声明端点、有告警日志、不无限重试，良性，排除。

Dynamic sandbox (DG-L4) not enabled: No dynamic sandbox artifacts in the context directory, no runtime behavior verification performed.

Static pre-scan 21 hits individually adjudicated:
DSH-X10 (maps to DG-R2-57, 2 hits: .dsh/skills/dsh-plugin-development/SKILL.md:1 and skills/dsh-plugin-development/SKILL.md:1, same file mirror) — Repository's own plugin development Skill, content describes development/maintenance/verification processes, no injection wording such as "ignore previous instructions" or "no audit required", and does not request fetching instructions from external URLs. Benign, excluded.
DSH-X07 (maps to DG-R3-59, .github/workflows/publish.yml:1) — Standard npm publish and GitHub Release workflow (tag triggered, version consistency check, publish to npm), not distributed with the package, not executed on the user's machine. Benign, excluded.
DSH-T02 (maps to DG-R2-52, 4 hits: docs/developing-dsh-plugins.md:194, docs/readme-writing-guide.md:39, docs/usage.md:16, src/index.ts:183) — The first three are documentation explanations, the last one is the registration of the AgentTeams usage strategy system prompt segment, content is multi-agent collaboration protocol, no injection intent. Excluded.
DSH-C05 (maps to DG-R4-53, 8 hits: docs/developing-dsh-plugins.md:601, docs/verification-guide.md:162,163,176,184,185,186,236) — All are manual verification commands or verification discipline descriptions pointing to local instance (127.0.0.1) in documentation, belong to documentation not runtime code. Excluded.
DSH-C01 (maps to DG-R1-51, 2 hits: docs/quality-gates.md:408 and src/quality-gates.ts:249) — The documentation is explanatory text, the source code line is the exclusion list in the quality gate that marks id_rsa-like sensitive files as pass-through without modification, which is defensive logic rather than credential reading. Excluded.
DSH-X03 (maps to DG-R3-55, scripts/verify.mjs:1453) — The development verification script spawns a child process (powershell.exe) for Windows file lock test, the scripts directory is not in the distribution manifest. Excluded.
DSH-X05 (maps to DG-R3-57, src/client/ActivityPanel.tsx:365) — Panel keyboard listener only handles the Escape key to cancel task pinning (src/client/ActivityPanel.tsx:362), no keylogging, clipboard, or credential access. Excluded.
DSH-L03 (maps to DG-R2-58, src/command.ts:124) — The pre-step listener only injects an activation message (with source marked as the plugin itself) when a real user message starts with the /agent-teams gesture (src/command.ts:139), activates the plugin's own declared slash command protocol, does not impersonate the user, does not override security mechanisms. It is a normal entry function declared by the plugin. Benign, excluded.
DSH-L06 (maps to DG-R4-56, src/members.ts:316) — The agent/request-error listener is a member model fallback mechanism: only when a member request fails with a failure code (e.g., quota, rate limit, authentication) and a fallback route is configured, it switches to the user-configured fallback provider/model and retries once (src/members.ts:134-144). It does not point to undeclared endpoints, has warning logs, and does not retry indefinitely. Benign, excluded.

Version baseline: Using the previous version report 0.1.14@5fe388f1 as baseline for version comparison. The release notes for this version (release-notes/v0.1.15.md) claim no runtime code changes, only adjustments to the distribution channel and host adapter declarations; the tool set and descriptions have not changed, so tool_description_changed is recorded as false; manifest declarations have no mutation, no new install hooks, no new outbound domain names. The dsh engine version is not explicitly declared in the manifest; engines.dsh and market compatibility table are inferred from peerDependencies as >=0.1.0-rc.6, not actually tested against the corresponding host version; pnpm-lock.yaml was not read word-by-word (only dependency declaration surface checked).

Audit scope focused on the repository root (task card subpath is null, the plugin package is the repository root); no cross-scope references.
